rules.R2: sitemap index -> first child containing 'pdp' or 'product'; urlset -> RU product URL of the first matching pilot row; none -> stop
rules.R3: after a sitemap: RU product page of the first matching pilot row, else second pdp/product child, else stop; after a product page: the first support/manual link printed on it under www.lg.com, else stop

stop_rule: 401/403/429 or confirmed challenge: host stopped in data/lg_fetch_log.json, probe ends
